calendar_total_variance_mid.method: earlier mid total variance vs the later expiry's mid total variance interpolated linearly in k (diagnostic, not a certificate)

arbitrage.constraint_set: CRW 2020 Table 1: C1-C3 per expiry; C4, C5 and C6 (C6.1 a/b/c and the nearest-neighbour chord) between consecutive expiries only; see arbitrage.py

fit_set.rule: alternate strikes per expiry (even positions by strike), minus quotes the l1-BA repair moves outside their spread

essvi.description: eSSVI global surface (theta, psi, rho per expiry); Gatheral-Jacquier butterfly conditions, monotone theta and wing slopes, and slice ordering certified on a 4,001-point k-grid; inverse half-spread weights

calendar_ordering.check_grid: essvi.CHECK_GRID (4,001 points on k in [-3, 2] plus |k| = 10, 30)

svi.description: raw SVI per expiry; Durrleman g(k) >= 0 on 241 points of k in [-1.5, 1] and Lee wing bounds; no calendar constraint between slices; inverse half-spread weights

calendar_ordering.check_grid: essvi.CHECK_GRID (4,001 points on k in [-3, 2] plus |k| = 10, 30)

svi_cal.description: raw SVI per expiry with Durrleman g(k) >= 0 on 241 points of k in [-1.5, 1] and Lee wing bounds, and calendar ordering w_(i-1) <= w_i <= w_(i+1) certified on a 4,001-point k-grid and in the wing slopes; block coordinate descent from the eSSVI fit; inverse half-spread weights

ordering.check_grid: essvi.CHECK_GRID (4,001 points on k in [-3, 2] plus |k| = 10, 30)

universe_filters.note: identical to JointCalibrator.spx_surface_full; 0-6 DTE expiries are excluded, as in the calibrator
